# sherpa-progress-bar

Horizontal task-progress indicator, built on native &lt;progress>. Fill/track are styled via the vendor pseudo-elements (::-webkit-progress-bar / -value, ::-moz-progress-bar); indeterminate = value removed, not set to 0.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Figma | Progress Bar (atom) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-progress-bar data-label="Upload" value="40"></sherpa-progress-bar>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-indeterminate` | boolean | `false` | animated sweep for unknown-duration work (boolean; renders a native indeterminate &lt;progress> — no value) |
| `data-label` | text |  | accessible task label (shown above the bar; drives aria-label) |
| `data-status` | `critical` `warning` `success` `info` |  | critical \| warning \| success \| info (colours the fill) |
| `value` | text, native |  | 0–100 completion (native &lt;progress value>); read/write |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number` | read and write | the current percentage (read/write, clamped 0–100) |

`bar`, `label`
